policy_summary: Overnight motorhome parking prohibited in all council car parks, with a 12-month trial of 10 designated spaces at Thrunscoe Lane car park, Cleethorpes, at GBP12 per 24 hours and a 48-hour maximum. Required a change to the Parking Order - a clear example of the instrument being an off-street parking order rather than a PSPO. A height restrictor was installed at Marine Walk to deter unauthorised use.
open_questions: Is the blanket prohibition still in force?

sites.name: Thrunscoe Lane Car Park, Cleethorpes
sites.notes: GBP12 per 24 hours, 48-hour maximum. Hard standing near the Cleethorpes Coast Light Railway. Trial approved April 2023.
